prompts.title: 两名人物的戏剧性数字绘画肖像
prompts.description: 一个详细的提示，用于生成一幅戏剧性的数字绘画肖像，描绘一位年轻女性和一位年轻男性，采用大胆的图形艺术风格。该提示指定了黑、白、深红和鲜黄色的高对比度调色板，重点是电影般的灯光、富有表现力的笔触和高分辨率，以营造一种英勇和鼓舞人心的氛围。
prompts.content: A dramatic digital painting portrait composition featuring two powerful subjects in a bold graphic art style. The scene uses a high-contrast palette dominated by black, white, deep red, and vibrant yellow paint strokes forming an expressive abstract background. On the left, a young woman is shown from the shoulders up, looking slightly upward with a strong, determined expression. Her face is rendered in monochrome grayscale with smooth yet painterly shading, emphasizing sharp cheekbones, defined lips, and reflective eyes gazing toward the sky. Her medium-length hair flows naturally around her face with soft strands catching subtle highlights. The lighting is cinematic and directional from above, creating dramatic shadows under the jawline and nose, giving the portrait a heroic and inspirational mood. On the right side, a young athletic man stands in a three-quarter body view wearing a fitted dark t-shirt and jeans. His physique is muscular and natural, with visible arm definition. He also looks upward with a calm but resolute expression, symbolizing ambition and determination. His face and body are rendered in grayscale realism with bold brush textures, while the background explodes with dynamic vertical paint streaks and abstract strokes of red, yellow, and black. The brushwork appears energetic and expressive, resembling modern poster art or street-style digital illustration. The composition balances realism and painterly abstraction, with sharp facial detail contrasted against rough expressive background strokes. Ultra-high detail, cinematic lighting, dramatic contrast, textured brush strokes, modern digital painting, heroic portrait style, inspirational mood, high resolution, 8k quality, sharp focus, studio-quality rendering.
prompts.translatedContent: 一幅引人注目的数字绘画肖像构图，以大胆的图形艺术风格展现了两个强大的主体。场景采用高对比度调色板，以黑色、白色、深红色和鲜艳的黄色笔触为主，形成富有表现力的抽象背景。左侧描绘了一位年轻女性，从肩膀以上入画，她略微向上看，表情坚定而有力。她的脸部以单色灰度呈现，平滑而富有绘画感的阴影突出了她分明的颧骨、清晰的嘴唇和凝视天空的反射性眼睛。她的中长发自然地环绕着脸庞，柔和的发丝捕捉到微妙的高光。光线是电影化的，从上方投射下来，在下颌线和鼻下形成戏剧性的阴影，赋予肖像一种英雄主义和鼓舞人心的氛围。右侧是一位年轻的运动型男性，以四分之三身姿站立，身穿合身的深色 T 恤和牛仔裤。他的体格健硕自然，手臂线条清晰可见。他也向上看，表情平静而坚定，象征着抱负和决心。他的脸部和身体以灰度写实风格呈现，带有大胆的笔触纹理，而背景则以红色、黄色和黑色的动态垂直颜料条纹和抽象笔触爆发开来。笔触显得充满活力和表现力，类似于现代海报艺术或街头风格的数字插画。构图平衡了写实主义和绘画抽象，锐利的面部细节与粗犷富有表现力的背景笔触形成对比。超高细节、电影级光照、戏剧性对比、纹理笔触、现代数字绘画、英雄肖像风格、鼓舞人心的氛围、高分辨率、8k 画质、锐利焦点、工作室品质渲染。

prompts.title: 春日花园中超逼真的儿童时尚快照
prompts.description: 生成一张 8K 超写实抓拍照片，描绘一个 7 岁男孩在盛开的樱花花园中，重点突出潮流的中国儿童时尚（oversized 毛衣、渔夫帽），并运用浅景深和运动模糊等相机效果。
prompts.content:
Without changing his face, make a 8K hyper-realistic photo of a 7-year-old boy in a blooming spring garden filled with cherry blossom trees. He is wearing an oversized pastel mint knitted sweater with playful embroidered cartoon clouds and tiny 3D patch details, layered over a long white extended-hem tee. Bottoms: loose cream wide-leg shorts with soft pleats and elastic waistband. Footwear: chunky pastel sneakers with thick playful soles. Accessories: oversized soft bucket hat in baby pink and a tiny plush character crossbody bag.

The camera is very close as he runs past, sweater sleeves slightly covering his hands, fabric bouncing. Slight motion blur on edges of sweater and blossoms. Expression: mischievous playful glare with confident smirk.

Shot on a modern smartphone in natural daylight, candid snapshot style. Sunlight filtering through blossoms, creating soft highlights and dreamy floral bokeh. Oversized silhouette dominates the frame, giving that trendy Chinese kids fashion vibe.

不改变面部特征，制作一张 8K 超写实照片，照片中一个 7 岁男孩身处繁花盛开的春日花园，樱花树环绕。他身穿一件超大款薄荷色针织毛衣，上面绣有俏皮的卡通云朵和微小的 3D 贴片细节，内搭一件白色长款下摆 T 恤。下身：宽松的米色阔腿短裤，带有柔软的褶皱和松紧腰带。鞋履：厚实的马卡龙色运动鞋，鞋底厚实且富有玩趣。配饰：一个超大款的婴儿粉色柔软渔夫帽和一个迷你毛绒卡通斜挎包。

当他跑过时，镜头非常近，毛衣袖子略微遮住他的手，衣料随之摆动。毛衣边缘和花朵有轻微的运动模糊。表情：带着自信的坏笑，眼神调皮而狡黠。

使用现代智能手机在自然日光下拍摄，采用抓拍风格。阳光透过花朵，营造出柔和的高光和梦幻般的花卉散景。超大廓形占据画面主体，呈现出当下流行的中国儿童时尚感。

prompts.content:
Create a high-contrast black-and-white cinematic portrait of a British woman around 25 years old with natural facial proportions, expressive eyes, defined cheekbones, and realistic skin texture with visible pores. Her expression is calm, confident, and introspective, looking directly at the camera.
She is posed thoughtfully with one hand gently resting on her chin, head slightly angled. Her hair is shoulder-length with natural volume and visible strand detail.
Use low-key studio lighting with a key light slightly above eye level from the viewer’s left, creating sculpted highlights on the forehead, nose bridge, and cheekbones with deep but detailed shadows. Add a subtle rim light on the hair and shoulders for separation.
Background is pure black with no texture. Tight head-and-shoulders composition (4:5), sharp focus on the eyes with shallow depth of field.
Style: cinematic fine-art monochrome photography, ultra-realistic, editorial studio quality, high detail.

prompts.title: 极简电影感时尚专题影棚肖像
prompts.description: 一个详细的提示，用于 Google Gemini Nano Banana Pro，以一个人的照片作为身份参考，创作一张极简电影风格的时尚社论工作室肖像。它指定了构图、姿势、服装（黑色吸烟夹克）、戏剧性的高对比度照明，以及一个带有微妙发光光晕效果的纯黑色背景。
prompts.content:
Using a person's photo as the identity reference, create a minimalist cinematic fashion-editorial studio portrait. Vertical 4:5, mid-torso to head framing with generous negative space above, subject slightly left of center.

Pose: shoulders angled 3/4, head turned back toward camera, chin slightly lifted. Expression calm, cool, slightly aloof, eyes relaxed and focused.

Wardrobe: {argument name="wardrobe" default="black smoking (tuxedo jacket)"}, no logos, no jewelry.

Lighting: dramatic high-contrast studio lighting. A strong neutral key light from camera-right/front-right sculpting the face and coat, deep falloff into shadow on the far side, with a very subtle low-intensity soft fill from camera-left.

Background: completely black studio environment. Behind the subject’s head, a soft diffused backlight creating a subtle glowing halo with cinematic bloom, not a solid circle. The light softly radiates outward and gradually dissolves into pure black (#000000), creating a gentle atmospheric glow around the silhouette. No visible light source, no hard edges, no textures.

Optics: 85mm portrait look, f/2–f/2.8 shallow depth of field (eyes tack sharp, background creamy), pronounced highlight bloom, soft halation around the backlight, smooth cinematic contrast, subtle film grain, crisp micro-texture in fabric weave, controlled natural skin texture.

No text, no watermark. Editorial, modern, high-detail, cinematic composition, ultra-realistic textures, professional fashion photography style.
prompts.translatedContent:
以人物照片作为身份参考，创作一张极简电影风格的时尚杂志工作室肖像照。纵向 4:5 构图，从躯干中部到头部取景，上方留有充足的负空间，主体略微偏离中心靠左。

姿势：肩膀呈 3/4 角度，头部转向镜头，下巴略微抬起。表情平静、冷酷、略带疏离感，眼神放松且专注。

服装：{argument name="wardrobe" default="黑色吸烟装（燕尾服夹克）"}，无品牌标志，无珠宝。

灯光：戏剧性的高对比度工作室灯光。从相机右侧/前右侧打来一束强烈的自然主光，勾勒出面部和外套的轮廓，远侧深度渐变为阴影，从相机左侧打来一束非常微妙的低强度柔和补光。

背景：完全黑色的工作室环境。在主体头部后方，一束柔和的漫射背光营造出微妙的发光光晕，带有电影般的弥散效果，而非实心圆。光线柔和地向外辐射，并逐渐融入纯黑色（#000000），在轮廓周围形成一种柔和的氛围光。无可见光源，无硬边，无纹理。

光学效果：85mm 人像镜头效果，f/2–f/2.8 浅景深（眼睛锐利，背景奶油般柔和），明显的高光溢出，背光周围柔和的光晕，流畅的电影对比度，微妙的胶片颗粒感，织物纹理清晰的微观细节，受控的自然皮肤纹理。

无文字，无水印。杂志风格，现代感，高细节，电影构图，超现实纹理，专业时尚摄影风格。
